description: House rules for an EverLoop package. The SAME file is loaded by the Claude skill's `check` step and by the server's upload checker, so a package that passes locally passes on upload. Add rules only; never rename or remove an id. The server rejects any manifest whose rulesHash does not match the server's copy of this file.
note: Patterns are intentionally broad (they flag for human/author review). A finding is a reason to look, not always a hard block — but a package must have ZERO unresolved `error` findings to pass upload. Never weaken a rule to make a check pass.

rules.message: External resource reference found. An EverLoop package must be fully self-contained — bundle all scripts, styles, fonts and images into the package instead of linking to a CDN or external site.
rules.fix: Download the resource into the package (e.g. /assets) and reference it with a relative path like ./assets/name.ext.

rules.message: Network call detected. Packages have no network access (the player blocks it). All data flows through EverLoop events, not HTTP.
rules.fix: Remove the network call. To record progress/scores/rewards, use the EverLoop.* event API. To read state, use EverLoop.progress.get/all, EverLoop.achievements.list and EverLoop.onUpdate.

rules.message: Browser storage used. Packages must not store student data or progress locally — EverLoop is the single source of truth.
rules.fix: Replace progress saves with EverLoop.progress(activityId, {saveSlot}) (opaque resume blob) and read restored state with EverLoop.progress.get/all on resume.

rules.message: Attempt to open a window or reach the parent/top frame. The player blocks popups and navigation; reaching the parent frame is not allowed.
rules.fix: Remove the popup/navigation. Keep all UI inside the app. Communicate with EverLoop only through the EverLoop.* API.

rules.message: Login or password input found. Packages must never collect credentials or personal data; the student is already authenticated by EverLoop.
rules.fix: Remove the login/password fields. Use EverLoop.student.displayName if you need to greet the student.

rules.message: Third-party analytics/tracking snippet found. Packages must not phone home or track students.
The package must contain index.html at its root (the fixed entry point).
rules.fix: Run the `pack` step, which places index.html at the root of the zip.

rules.message: The package must include the EverLoop connector at a supported version and load it from index.html.
rules.fix: Run the `connect` step to add everloop-connector.js and reference it from index.html before your app scripts.

rules.message: Dynamic code execution (eval / Function / string timers). The player's CSP blocks most of this; it will likely break at runtime.
rules.fix: Replace eval/Function and string-based timers with direct function references.

rules.message: Remote web font. Fonts must be bundled; remote fonts are blocked by the player.
rules.fix: Download the font files into the package and reference them with a relative url(./assets/font.woff2).
